LanguageData.LP_CS_Friends.label: friends
LanguageData.LP_CS_Friends.description: Cantrip (Enchantment): for 1 minute, social impact +30% and negotiation ability +30% (recruiting, trading and persuading are all easier). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Heroism.label: heroism
LanguageData.LP_CS_Heroism.description: Circle 1 (Enchantment, concentration): one ally within 20 cells is fearless for 1 minute (recovers at once from panic), and every second their temporary hit points are topped up to 6 × power (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Tongues.label: tongues
LanguageData.LP_CS_Tongues.description: Circle 3 (Divination): one friendly person within 10 cells becomes silver-tongued for 1 hour: negotiation ability ×2, social impact +50% (use the time to recruit, persuade surrender or trade). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_HypnoticPattern.label: hypnotic pattern
LanguageData.LP_CS_HypnoticPattern.description: Circle 3 (Illusion, concentration): shifting patterns of light appear in radius 3 within 20 cells: enemies inside each have a 55% chance to stare transfixed and fall asleep for 12 seconds (waking when hurt). -5% per level the target is above the caster (minimum 10%), halved against legendary creatures and story bosses; mind resistance also resists it, no effect on mechanoids (concentration). Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Compulsion.label: befuddlement
LanguageData.LP_CS_Compulsion.description: Circle 4 (Enchantment): enemies in radius 4 within 20 cells each have a 55% chance to be forced to walk 5 cells away and freeze for 1.5 seconds (mind resistance resists it, no effect on mechanoids). Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_GreaterInvisibility.label: greater invisibility
LanguageData.LP_CS_GreaterInvisibility.description: Circle 4 (Illusion, concentration): one ally within 20 cells turns invisible for 1 minute and stays hidden even when attacking or casting (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MassSuggestion.label: mass suggestion: withdraw
LanguageData.LP_CS_MassSuggestion.description: Circle 6 (Enchantment): cast on one member of a hostile squad within 30 cells, with success chance calculated as for Words of Truce (easier the higher the power and the more of them have fallen): on success the whole squad gives up the raid and leaves the map. No effect on groups of undead, outsiders, mechanoids, insectoids or led by story bosses. Cooldown 2 minutes.
LanguageData.LP_CS_OttoDance.label: Otto's irresistible dance
LanguageData.LP_CS_OttoDance.description: Circle 6 (Enchantment): one enemy within 30 cells breaks into an unstoppable dance and cannot move for 10 seconds (success chance as Blade Dance's frenzied dance, shorter for story bosses; no effect on mechanoids). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ProjectImage.label: project image
LanguageData.LP_CS_ProjectImage.description: Circle 7 (Illusion): project an illusion of yourself anywhere on the map: reveals the fog in radius 12 there; for 1 hour, ranged attacks against the caster have a 30% chance to miss (hitting the illusion). Cooldown 2 minutes.
LanguageData.LP_CS_PowerWordHeal.label: power word heal
LanguageData.LP_CS_PowerWordHeal.description: Circle 9 (Evocation): one ally within 10 cells has all injuries healed (except old scars), and is freed from stuns, fear, all control effects, blindness and poisoning. Cooldown 2 minutes.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteBlaze.label: searing smite
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteBlaze.description: Circle 1 (Evocation, upcastable): within 10 seconds, the next melee hit deals an extra 10 × power fire damage and sets the target alight. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 6 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteThunder.label: thunderous smite
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteThunder.description: Circle 1 (Evocation, upcastable): within 10 seconds, the next melee hit deals an extra 10 × power thunder (blunt) damage, knocking the target back 2 cells and dazing it for 1 second. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 6 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteSear.label: searing smite
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteSear.description: Circle 1 (Evocation, upcastable): within 10 seconds, the next melee hit deals an extra 6 × power fire damage, then the target burns for another 1.2 × power per second for 10 seconds. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 6 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_DetectEvil.label: detect evil
LanguageData.LP_CS_DetectEvil.description: Circle 1 (Divination): sense all undead, fiends and anomalous creatures on the map (a letter lists their positions) and reveal invisible enemies within 30 cells. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_MagicWeapon.label: magic weapon
LanguageData.LP_CS_MagicWeapon.description: Circle 2 (Transmutation, concentration): one ally's weapon within 20 cells is imbued with magic for 1 hour: every melee or ranged hit deals an extra 3 × power force damage (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_FindSteed.label: find steed
LanguageData.LP_CS_FindSteed.description: Circle 2 (Conjuration): summon a lasting celestial warhorse (a vanilla horse that belongs to the colony, bonds with the caster, learns all trainable skills, movement ×1.2, damage taken ×0.8). Only one at a time; can be summoned again if it dies. Cannot be ridden. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteBrand.label: branding smite
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteBrand.description: Circle 2 (Evocation, upcastable): within 10 seconds, the next hit (melee or ranged) deals an extra 10 × power radiant damage (doubled against undead and fiends); the target cannot turn invisible for 1 minute. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 6 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_CrusadersMantle.label: crusader's mantle
LanguageData.LP_CS_CrusadersMantle.description: Circle 3 (Evocation, concentration): for 1 minute, allies within 6 cells of the caster deal an extra 3 × power radiant damage on every melee hit (doubled against undead and fiends) (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ElementalWeapon.label: elemental weapon
LanguageData.LP_CS_ElementalWeapon.description: Circle 3 (Transmutation, concentration): one ally's weapon within 20 cells burns with elemental power for 1 hour: every melee or ranged hit deals an extra 5 × power fire damage (concentration). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteBlind.label: blinding smite
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteBlind.description: Circle 3 (Evocation, upcastable): within 10 seconds, the next melee hit deals an extra 14 × power radiant damage (doubled against undead and fiends) and blinds the target for 10 seconds. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteStagger.label: staggering smite
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteStagger.description: Circle 4 (Enchantment, upcastable): within 10 seconds, the next melee hit deals an extra 18 × power psychic damage and stuns the target for 3 seconds. Upcast: +25% effect per circle. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteBanish.label: banishing smite
LanguageData.LP_CS_SmiteBanish.description: Circle 5 (Conjuration): within 10 seconds, the next melee hit deals an extra 25 × power force damage; if the target has lost over half its health (health ≤ 50%) it is banished for 1 minute (except story bosses). Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Ensnaring.label: ensnaring strike
LanguageData.LP_CS_Ensnaring.description: Circle 1 (Conjuration): within 10 seconds, the next hit (melee or ranged) deals an extra 6 × power cut damage, with a 60% chance for thorns to entangle the target for 4 seconds. Cooldown 6 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_PassWithoutTrace.label: pass without trace
LanguageData.LP_CS_PassWithoutTrace.description: Circle 2 (Abjuration, concentration): the caster and up to 9 allies within 8 cells move silently for 1 hour: ranged attacks against them have a 30% chance to miss (concentration). Rangers in a caravan get an extra caravan button: for 1 day the chance of the caravan being ambushed is halved. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ConjureBarrage.label: conjure barrage
LanguageData.LP_CS_ConjureBarrage.description: Circle 3 (Conjuration): fire an 8-cell cone of arrows in one direction; enemies inside take 20 × power piercing damage. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_LightningArrow.label: lightning arrow
LanguageData.LP_CS_LightningArrow.description: Circle 3 (Transmutation): within 10 seconds, the next ranged hit turns into a bolt of lightning: an extra 20 × power lightning damage, and enemies within 2 cells of the target each take half. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_SwiftQuiver.label: swift quiver
LanguageData.LP_CS_SwiftQuiver.description: Circle 5 (Transmutation, concentration): for 1 minute, ranged attack cooldown and aiming time are halved (concentration). Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_ConjureVolley.label: conjure volley
LanguageData.LP_CS_ConjureVolley.description: Circle 5 (Conjuration): fire a sky-filling volley of arrows at a point within 40 cells: enemies within radius 4 take 30 × power piercing damage. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_AbsorbElements.label: absorb elements
LanguageData.LP_CS_AbsorbElements.description: Circle 1 (Abjuration): within 10 seconds, the next elemental damage taken (fire, cold, lightning, acid, psychic) is halved; after blocking it, the next melee hit deals an extra 8 × power fire damage. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Identify.label: identify
LanguageData.LP_CS_Identify.description: Circle 1 (Divination, ritual): tell the quality, enchantment level, whether cursed, whether it has a magic aura, and value of one item within 10 cells. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_HeatMetal.label: heat metal
LanguageData.LP_CS_HeatMetal.description: Circle 2 (Transmutation): heat the metal on one enemy within 20 cells red-hot: 6 × power fire damage (doubled if wearing metal armor), then those in metal armor take another 3 × power fire damage per second for 10 seconds. Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Levitate.label: levitate
LanguageData.LP_CS_Levitate.description: Circle 2 (Transmutation): one ally within 10 cells floats a foot above the ground for 1 hour: no slowdown from terrain, snow or plants, movement ×0.9. Cooldown 20 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CS_Creation.label: fabricate
LanguageData.LP_CS_Creation.description: Circle 5 (Illusion, ritual): create a common material out of thin air: spellcasting class level × 10 steel, wood, cloth or granite blocks, or level / 2 components. Once per day. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_CS_AnimateObjects.label: animate objects
LanguageData.LP_CS_AnimateObjects.description: Circle 5 (Transmutation, concentration): bring stone blocks within 15 cells to life: summon 1 animated statue to fight for the caster for 1 minute (concentration); it falls apart when time is up. Cooldown 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_CS_BigbysHand.label: Bigby's hand
LanguageData.LP_CS_BigbysHand.description: Circle 5 (Evocation): summon a huge hand of force: one enemy within 24 cells takes 25 × power force damage, is pushed back 3 cells and dazed for 2 seconds. Cooldown 30 seconds.
